pages.text: The Clay Incense Burner makes a real, persistent calm zone. Right-click it with incense bundles or dried herbs to fuel it; a burning bundle lasts two minutes. Players within seven blocks gradually lose Stress and Fatigue. You can right-click empty-handed to check remaining time.

A Herbal Poultice relieves stress and fatigue on demand, but does not remove Sleep Debt. Its cooldown prevents spam. A Sleep Journal reports your current three stats, last rest quality and recovered debt.
